rules: One prediction per HIGH confidence pick, minimum 30 words, written individually (no templates).
Every factual claim carries a source URL. official=true means the governing body / league / tour published it.
Where a required element (e.g. verified recent form for one player) could not be confirmed, it is listed in unverified and NOT guessed.

predictions.match: Afghanistan vs Bangladesh One Day Match (3rd ODI, UAE Tri-Series)
predictions.headline: Afghanistan's 158-run demolition of Zimbabwe makes them the side to beat in Sharjah
predictions.body: Afghanistan go into Wednesday's third ODI against Bangladesh at Sharjah as the form team of the tri-series. On 19 October they thumped Zimbabwe by 158 runs in Abu Dhabi, with Sediqullah Atal making 102, Ibrahim Zadran 90 and Rashid Khan taking four for 17 as Zimbabwe were bowled out for 136 chasing 295. That result left Afghanistan and Zimbabwe level on two points, so this match decides who joins Zimbabwe in Friday's final. Afghanistan's spin attack, led by Rashid, is the clear edge on a Sharjah surface that has historically rewarded slow bowling, and Bangladesh's batting folded for 172 in their opening game against Zimbabwe. Selection: Afghanistan to win the match.

facts.claim: The ODI tri-series runs 17-23 October 2026 in the UAE, with the Afghanistan v Bangladesh fixture on 21 October and the final on 23 October.

Afghanistan beat Zimbabwe by 158 runs on 19 October: Afghanistan 294 (Atal 102, Zadran 90), Zimbabwe 136 (Rashid 4-17); both teams on two points with Afghanistan v Bangladesh the only group game left.
facts.publisher: ESPNcricinfo (specialist press, not the governing body)

facts.claim: The first two tri-series matches are in Abu Dhabi and the remaining two, including the 3rd ODI, in Sharjah.
facts.publisher: Ariana News, reporting the ACB announcement (secondary)

facts.claim: The Afghanistan Cricket Board confirmed it hosts Bangladesh and Zimbabwe in the UAE in October-November 2026, including an ODI tri-nation series from 17-23 October.
OLBG's page for this fixture carried 7/7 win tips on Afghanistan (100%) at capture.

unverified: Venue is contradictory across sources: the ACB briefing (via Ariana News) puts the last two matches in Sharjah and ESPNcricinfo's scorecard header says Sharjah, while an ESPNcricinfo match page also lists Abu Dhabi. Confirmed as a flag, not resolved.
Bangladesh's XI and toss were not published at capture time, so no team-news claim is made.

predictions.match: North West Dragons vs Limpopo Impalas (CSA T20 Challenge, Senwes Park)
predictions.headline: Home venue and a 3-1 recent run make North West the call against Limpopo
predictions.body: North West Dragons host Limpopo Impalas at Senwes Park in Potchefstroom on Wednesday with the better recent record of the two. Cricket South Africa's own results log shows North West beating Warriors by seven wickets on 25 September, losing to Border by 13 runs on 28 September, then beating Lions by six wickets on 2 October before a six-wicket defeat to South Western Districts on 10 October. Limpopo's logged results in the same competition are defeats to Warriors by 35 runs and to South Western Districts by five wickets. A 3-1 return against Limpopo's 0-2 start, plus home conditions in Potchefstroom, is enough to make North West the selection at the price our model sets.

facts.claim: CSA T20 Challenge 2026 runs 25 September to 14 November 2026 across 16 teams and 67 matches, administered by Cricket South Africa.
Fixture on 21 October 2026: North West Dragons v Limpopo at Senwes Park, Potchefstroom.
North West results: beat Warriors by 7 wickets (25 Sep), lost to Border by 13 runs (28 Sep), beat Lions by 6 wickets (2 Oct), lost to South Western Districts by 6 wickets (10 Oct).
Limpopo results: lost to Warriors by 35 runs (29 Sep) and to South Western Districts by 5 wickets (5 Oct).
OLBG carried 5/6 win tips on North West Dragons (83%).

unverified: No team sheets or toss information were published at capture; no player-level claims are made.
Squad availability for either side is not confirmed by an official source in this capture.

predictions.match: Eastern Storm vs Tuskers (CSA T20 Challenge, Willowmoore Park)
predictions.headline: Backing Eastern Storm at home despite a poor run, because the model still rates them
predictions.body: Eastern Storm meet KwaZulu-Natal Inland Tuskers at Willowmoore Park in Benoni on Thursday, and our number says Eastern Storm even though their logged form is poor. Cricket South Africa's results show them beaten by nine wickets by Western Province on 6 October, tied with Boland on 8 October, then hammered by 99 runs by Titans on 11 October. The case for the home side is venue and the market's read rather than momentum: all four OLBG win tips on this fixture went to Eastern Storm, and our shrinkage model turns that unanimous but thin support into a 0.833 probability. This is a low-conviction bet on home advantage, and the staking note should reflect that.

facts.claim: Fixture on 22 October 2026: Eastern Storm v KwaZulu-Natal Inland Tuskers at Willowmoore Park, Benoni.
Eastern Storm results: lost to Western Province by 9 wickets (6 Oct), tied with Boland (8 Oct), lost to Titans by 99 runs (11 Oct).

unverified: Tuskers' recent T20 Challenge results were not on the captured CSA page for this date, so their form is left blank rather than inferred.

predictions.match: Leylah Fernandez vs Aliaksandra Sasnovich (WTA 500 Ningbo, round of 16)
predictions.headline: Fernandez's three-set comeback over Mertens points to a last-16 win in Ningbo
predictions.body: Leylah Fernandez arrives in the Ningbo round of 16 after the best win of her Asian swing, coming from 5-3 down in the decider to beat seventh seed Elise Mertens 2-6, 6-3, 7-5 in two hours and 49 minutes, a result the WTA billed as her fifth top-20 win of 2026. Aliaksandra Sasnovich is through as a qualifier, which means she has already played extra matches on the same hard courts but against a lower level of opposition. Ranking, seeding and the quality of the win just posted all point one way. Selection: Fernandez to win the match, with our model pricing her around 1/3.

facts.claim: WTA 500 BNB Ningbo Open runs 19-25 October 2026 on hard courts in Ningbo, China, with prize money of $1,206,446; Sasnovich is listed as a qualifier and Fernandez as a main-draw player.
Fernandez beat No.7 seed Elise Mertens 2-6, 6-3, 7-5 in the first round, coming from 5-3 down in the third set in 2 hours 49 minutes for her fifth top-20 win of 2026.
Official draw shows the round-of-32 scoreline Mertens 6-3-5 v Fernandez 2-6-7.
OLBG carried 6/7 win tips on Fernandez (86%).

unverified: Sasnovich's first-round score is reported by secondary outlets but was not captured from an official WTA results page, so it is not quoted here.
Head-to-head record is excluded: the WTA pages captured do not publish it, and secondary H2H figures conflicted.

predictions.match: MIL Bucks @ WAS Wizards (NBA, Capital One Arena)
predictions.headline: Season opener at home: Washington's reshaped roster gets the nod over Milwaukee
predictions.body: Washington open the 2026-27 season at home against Milwaukee, and the model makes the Wizards a 0.769 favourite after nine of eleven OLBG tips landed on them. Both teams tip off at 0-0, so this is a genuine opener with no regular-season form to lean on. Milwaukee's most recent listed game was a 128-127 overtime win over Indiana on 16 October, per the NBA's own Bucks schedule page, while Washington closed pre-season with a 107-106 loss at New Orleans on 17 October. With no head-to-head form yet, home court plus the stronger closing pre-season margin tilts it. Selection: Washington Wizards money line.

facts.claim: Milwaukee Bucks at Washington Wizards is scheduled for 21 October 2026, 7:00 PM ET.
Both teams are listed 0-0 heading into the fixture; Milwaukee's previous listed game was a 128-127 overtime win over Indiana on 16 October.
OLBG carried 9/11 win tips on the Wizards (82%).

unverified: Washington's 107-106 pre-season loss at New Orleans on 17 October comes from a schedule aggregator, not from an NBA page captured here; treat as unconfirmed.
Injury reports were not published by an official source at capture and are not asserted.

predictions.match: Luke Woodhouse vs Dirk van Duijvenbode (European Championship, round one)
predictions.headline: Van Duijvenbode's superior seed earns the call in a best-of-11 opener in Dortmund
predictions.body: This is a first-round tie at the 2026 Machineseeker European Championship at the Westfalenhalle in Dortmund, a £750,000 PDC Premier event running 22-25 October, and it is played over the best of 11 legs. The official draw bracket seeds Dirk van Duijvenbode 24th and Luke Woodhouse ninth, and Woodhouse arrives off a 6-2 quarter-final defeat to Danny Noppert at the Dutch Darts Championship on 18 October, where Noppert then reached the final. Van Duijvenbode did not feature in that latter stage, so the edge here is thinner than the market implies. Selection: van Duijvenbode to win the match, at a shorter price than his seeding alone would justify.

facts.claim: European Championship 2026: Westfalenhalle Dortmund, 22-25 October, 32-player field, £750,000 prize fund, round one best of 11 legs, Thursday 22 October session 1900-2300 CEST; Luke Woodhouse v Dirk van Duijvenbode is the opening tie.
Official draw bracket seeds Woodhouse 9 and van Duijvenbode 24.
Woodhouse lost 6-2 to Danny Noppert in the Dutch Darts Championship quarter-finals on 18 October.
OLBG carried 7/8 win tips on van Duijvenbode (88%).

unverified: Van Duijvenbode's most recent match results are not published in the PDC pages captured, so his form is a gap rather than a claim.

predictions.match: Niels Zonneveld vs Cameron Menzies (European Championship, round one)
predictions.headline: Fresh from a maiden title in Maastricht, Zonneveld is the pick against Menzies
predictions.body: Niels Zonneveld walks into Dortmund as a title winner. On 18 October he claimed his first PDC ranking title at the Dutch Darts Championship, beating Danny Noppert 8-5 in the final in front of a 5,000-strong home crowd at the MECC Maastricht, banking £35,000, rising to world number 28 and sealing a Grand Slam of Darts debut. He also beat Stephen Bunting 7-4 in the semi-finals. Cameron Menzies lost 6-2 to Bunting in Maastricht on 17 October, so the two form lines cross sharply. The official draw seeds Zonneveld fourth and Menzies 29th. Selection: Zonneveld to win this best-of-11 first-round tie.

facts.claim: Zonneveld won the 2026 Dutch Darts Championship on 18 October, beating Danny Noppert 8-5 in the final, earning £35,000, becoming world number 28 and qualifying for the Grand Slam of Darts.
Zonneveld beat Stephen Bunting 7-4 in the semi-finals; Stephen Bunting beat Cameron Menzies 6-2 earlier in the same event.
Official draw bracket seeds Zonneveld 4 and Menzies 29, and schedules Niels Zonneveld v Cameron Menzies on Thursday 22 October, best of 11 legs.
OLBG carried 6/7 win tips on Zonneveld (86%).

unverified: Menzies' full Maastricht run beyond the 6-2 defeat to Bunting is not detailed in the PDC pages captured.

predictions.match: Danny Noppert vs Stephen Bunting (European Championship, round one)
predictions.headline: Two in-form seeds over a short format: the 9.50 legs line looks too low
predictions.body: Danny Noppert and Stephen Bunting both reached the semi-finals in Maastricht three days before this tie, and both lost to the eventual champion's half of the draw. Noppert beat Luke Woodhouse 6-2 and Gian van Veen 7-5 before losing the final 8-5 to Niels Zonneveld, while Bunting beat Damon Heta 6-3 and Nathan Aspinall 6-1 before going out 7-4 to Zonneveld. Round one in Dortmund is best of 11 legs, so an over 9.50 line needs ten legs or more, meaning the match must reach 5-5 or a deciding leg. Two players arriving with heavy leg volume and tight recent margins make that likely. Selection: over 9.50 total legs.

facts.claim: Round one at the 2026 European Championship is best of 11 legs; Noppert v Bunting is the second tie on Thursday 22 October.
Noppert beat Woodhouse 6-2 in the quarter-finals, beat van Veen 7-5 in the semi-finals and lost the final 5-8 to Zonneveld.
Bunting beat Heta 6-3 in the quarter-finals and Aspinall 6-1 in round three, then lost 4-7 to Zonneveld in the semi-finals.
OLBG carried 4/4 win tips on over 9.50 total legs (100%).

unverified: No official leg-by-leg scoring distribution for either player's recent matches was published in the captured pages, so the over is a probability judgement, not a measured rate.

predictions.match: Elliot Slessor v Jamie Jones (Northern Ireland Open, last 32)
predictions.headline: Match-sharp Jones against a walkover-assisted Slessor in Belfast
predictions.body: Jamie Jones has played and won, while Elliot Slessor has not yet hit a ball in anger at the Waterfront Hall. Jones took out 13th seed Chris Wakelin 4-1 in the last 64 of the BetVictor Northern Ireland Open, a result that fitted the pattern of seeds tumbling in Belfast this week. Slessor advanced by walkover after He Guoqiang withdrew for medical reasons, so his only match practice is pre-tournament. The last 32 is best of seven frames, a format where sharpness matters, and Jones has it. Selection: Jamie Jones to win, priced by our model at around 1/4 on a unanimous but thin four-tip sample.

facts.claim: The BetVictor Northern Ireland Open is at the Waterfront Hall, Belfast, 18-25 October 2026, and several top seeds have already been eliminated.
Jamie Jones beat 13th seed Chris Wakelin 4-1 in the last 64; Elliot Slessor received a walkover against He Guoqiang, who withdrew for medical reasons.
